create_TwoWayTransformer: create a TwoWayTransformer decoder that attends to an input image using point queries with configurable depth and heads
build_TwoWayAttentionBlock: build a TwoWayAttentionBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and MLP layers for sparse token-image interaction
create_Attention_layer: create a downsampled multi-head Attention layer with query, key, value projections and softmax attention
run_TwoWayTransformer_forward: run a TwoWayTransformer forward pass with image embedding, positional encoding, and point embeddings to get processed queries and keys
run_TwoWayAttentionBlock_forward: run a TwoWayAttentionBlock forward pass with queries, keys, and positional encodings for bidirectional token-image attention
